title: Viral AI
oneLine: In-development multi-agent content platform for trend scouting, strategy, content generation and virality prediction.
description: Built for Craftathon 2k26, this in-development multi-agent platform automates trend scouting and content generation. Its stack includes CrewAI, Browser Use, FastAPI, Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and Redis, with authentication and pytest coverage.
